instrument: w6_reads.login(); f1_svc_run.call/scrub/stamp/say; plain opener as CENSUS does
how_the_vendor_request_was_chosen: Of every request listed by the two history GETs, keep those whose state member reads a ready token and whose provider member is NOT the Opal engine's, then take the most recent by the first present of accepted_at, created_at, submitted_at, updated_at, completed_at. If the item carries no provider member the provider filter is not applied and that is recorded in history_members_read as a null provider_member; if no request survives, the outcome is NO_VENDOR_REPORT_FOUND.
stopped_because: the service login could not be attempted: reading the password by name was refused (ClientError). No API call was made, no history was read, and the principal was NOT widened.
